t: You're at the site of Pinoli's Restaurant, which stood at 17 Wardour Street, with another frontage on Rupert Street. This was an Italian restaurant in what was then the Little Italy area of Soho, and it was founded in the 1890s. Carlo Pinoli, an Italian restaurateur who lived from 1851 to 1927, founded it, owned it, and gave it his name. He matters here because the restaurant was his, and its place in Soho's Italian community carries his name still.
